mail_to.description: Email address to receive the daily report (or 'stdout' for console output).

mail_from.description: Sender address shown in the 'From:' header of the report email.

format.description: Output format for the report: plain text or HTML.

detail.description: Verbosity level: 0 = minimal, 5 = normal, 9 = very detailed.

service_whitelist.description: List of specific services to include in the report. Leave empty to include all enabled services.

service_blacklist.description: List of services to explicitly exclude from the report.

temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files used during report generation.

log_dir.description: Base directory for LogWatch configuration (includes services/, conf/, etc.).

archive.description: Maximum number of days of log history to process (e.g., 7 = last 7 days).

compress.description: Whether to compress processed log files to save disk space.

ignore_old.description: Whether to ignore logs older than the Archive limit.

unassociated.description: Whether to include unclassified/unmatched log lines in the report.

date_prefix.description: Whether to prefix each log line with a full timestamp.

split_long_lines.description: Whether to reassemble split log lines (e.g., multi-line journal entries).

hostnames.description: Whether to include the system hostname in the report header.

range.description: Time range for log analysis (e.g., 'Yesterday', 'Today', 'Last 7 days').

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output for troubleshooting.

use_journal.description: Whether to read logs from systemd-journald instead of traditional log files.

journal_filters.description: Additional journalctl filter flags (e.g., '-u sshd', '--priority=crit') when UseJournal is enabled.

archive_days.description: Number of days to retain archived reports on disk (0 = keep indefinitely).
